overview.title: Assignments and feedback
overview.intro: Keep questions, submissions, protected files, and rubric-based feedback together.
overview.security: Uploaded files remain quarantined until malware scanning clears them.

create.title: Create an assignment
create.body: Tutors can set questions, due dates, and scoring guidance for their assigned students.

submit.title: Submit work
submit.body: Students can save answers and securely attach their work.

grade.title: Grade with a rubric
grade.body: Assigned tutors record scores and useful written feedback.
